procedure: Choose campaign premise, power scale, tone, and allowed sources.
Choose a concept and party function without treating roles as mandatory.
Assign core statistics using the edition-appropriate method.
Select archetype, class, playbook, profession, or point-built capabilities.
Select lineage, ancestry, species, culture, background, or origin only where the system uses them.
Choose skills, abilities, feats, edges, stunts, moves, powers, spells, gear, and relationships.
Calculate derived values and starting resources.
Write motivations, boundaries, connections, and advancement triggers.
Review overlap and gaps with the group, then make final adjustments.
